refreshDataHint: Update account balance, model list and relay groups; refresh wallet and usage on their own pages
loginSubtitle:
Sign in to see your balance and models,
then sync your choice to your local AI tools.
privacy: Secure connection to your relay over HTTPS
credentialsHint: Choose models, manage tools and review usage in one place
modelSubtitle: Apply a model to the enabled tools mapped to its group.
notAppliedHint: Choose a model below to sync it to your enabled tools.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the model ID manually.
emptyGroup: No models available in this group
emptyModels: No models available for this account
emptyModelsHint: Refresh the list or contact your relay administrator.
staleModels: Refresh failed. Showing previously loaded models.
targetsSubtitle: Choose which local tools receive your model selection.
statusPending: Status will update after the first sync
targetNotice: Tool toggles permit writes; group routing decides which tool is changed when a model in that group is selected.
groupRoutingHint: Groups come from the relay. Choose a target tool for each group; automatic suggestions use the group name only, never the model name.
noTargets: Enable at least one sync target first
targetDisabled: The recommended target for this model is disabled — enable it on the Targets page or pick another model
launchDesktopConfigWarning: {{name}} and the {{target}} CLI are separate entry points. It may not read the CLI configuration just saved.
relay.install_failed: Install failed — try again or install manually
backgroundSync: Sync continues when this dialog is closed.
helpBody: Check that the configuration directory is writable and its files are valid. Close programs locking those files, then try again.
failedKeepsPrevious: Sync did not complete. Your last successfully applied model is kept.
partialHint: Successful tools were updated. Review and retry the failed tools.
settingsSubtitle: Manage your account, appearance and local data.
diagnosticsHint: Export redacted local logs to troubleshoot connection and sync issues.
expired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
invalidCredentials: Check your username and password and try again.
loginFailed: The sign-in service could not complete the request. Try again later.
endpointUnavailable: The relay sign-in endpoint is unavailable. Check your connection or try again later.
network: Connection failed. Check your network and service address.
rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
invalidUrl: Enter a valid HTTPS relay address.
busy: Sync is in progress. Wait for it to finish.
genericError: The operation could not be completed. Retry or export diagnostics if the problem persists.
credentialMissing: No saved system credential was found. Please sign in again.
credentialStoreFailed: Saved credentials could not be accessed. Enter your username and password to sign in without credential-store permission.
accountRefreshFailed: Account refresh failed. Showing saved information.
ready: Models, tools and usage in one place
recoveryBody: Your data was created by a newer version or cannot be read. Keep your data and retry with a compatible RelayDesk version.
environmentSubtitle: Check local AI tools and review installation options.
environmentScope: AI tool and environment checks are read-only probes. Installs and fixes run only after your explicit confirmation.
envDiagnosticsScope: Exports environment check results and redacted app logs. Tokens, keys and account data are never included.
platformDetectedHint: Runtime hint: {{platform}}. This is not an installation, signing or terminal capability check.
platformHint_windows: Distribution formats: NSIS / MSI. Use winget or official guides for prerequisites. Desktop apps, Windows Terminal and WSL availability are not checked.
platformHint_macos: Distribution format: DMG (arm64 / x86_64). Consult Homebrew or official prerequisite guides. Desktop path detection is supported; signing, notarization and release availability are unverified.
platformHint_linux-desktop: Distribution formats: AppImage / deb. Desktop app and terminal emulator availability are not checked. See tool guides for CLI installation.
platformHint_linux-server: Headless / SSH deployment: copy the command from a tool guide and run it on the target server. A RelayDesk headless release and remote server checks are not available.
platformHint_linux-unknown: Linux desktop/server capabilities are unknown. Select a guidance profile; this does not change findings or enable desktop actions.
platformHint_unknown: Choose a platform to read its guidance. Local platform capabilities are not confirmed.
envFixHint: Installs automatically via the system package manager; this may take a few minutes. Keep the network connected.
envFixUnsupported: Automatic install isn't supported on this system. Open the official page to install it manually.
installConfirmationHint: Confirmation downloads and installs the tool locally from official sources. It will not launch the tool or undo your applied model.
installPlanLoading: Reading the actual installation plan from the backend…
installPlanFailed: The installation plan could not be loaded, so installation was blocked. Reopen this dialog to retry.
npmInstallLocations: The active npm global package and binary directories, and npm cache; a configured WSL tool runs inside its distribution.
claudeInstallLocations: Official installer user directories (such as ~/.local/bin and ~/.local/share/claude) and cache; the npm alternative changes global package directories.
claudeInstallFallback: macOS / Linux / WSL use the official claude.ai/install.sh installer; the existing installer tries the npm command above if that fails. Native Windows uses npm. Confirmation authorizes these disclosed installation paths.
installEnvironmentHint: The npm path requires Node.js/npm, whose availability is not checked. Installation progress is shown without a percentage. Once started, it cannot be cancelled here; wait for its result.
installFailedSafe: Installation failed. Check connectivity, permissions and prerequisites, then retry or consult the official guide. Raw installer output is hidden.
installedRecheckFailed: Installation completed, but rechecking failed. Close this dialog and check again.
manualInstallHint: Manual installation command (copying does not execute it). Set up Node.js/npm first and consult official platform requirements.
commandCopyFailed: Copy failed. Select the command manually.
guideOpenFailed: Could not open the guide. Try again later.
environmentOnboarding: Set up your AI tools now, or choose a model and visit Tool deployment from the sidebar later.
launchAppliedHint: Your model configuration is saved. You can launch the tool later.
launchFailed: The tool could not launch. Your model is still applied. Try again or check your environment.
groupRoutingEmpty: No configurable groups for this account
groupRoutingSaveFailed: Could not save. Your previous setting was restored. Try again.
groupRoutingDisabled: {{target}} is disabled. Enable it before applying a model from this group.
launchDesktopUnavailable: Desktop launching is unavailable on this platform. Install the CLI or view the guide.
deploymentSubtitle: Install AI tools and check your local environment.
deploymentHint: Install a missing CLI after reviewing its source and confirming the installation.
restartAvailableDesc: Supported targets can restart after confirmation. For manual steps, close this window and open the guide beside the toolbar button.
restartAppliedSeparate: Applying configuration and restarting are separate results. A running session may keep its old configuration; verify the model and connection after reopening.
restartSaveWork: Save your work and let any active generation or task finish.
restartExit_codex: Fully quit ChatGPT (Codex) or legacy Codex.app. For Codex CLI, exit its current session normally in the relevant terminal.
restartReopen_codex: Reopen the same desktop app, or run codex in your working directory. Start a new session and verify the configuration.
restartExit_claude: Exit the Claude Code CLI session normally in its terminal. Quitting Claude.app does not end this terminal session.
restartReopen_claude: Run claude in your working directory, start a new session and verify the model and connection settings.
restartExit_claudeDesktop: Save your work in desktop Code sessions, then quit Claude.app normally.
restartReopen_claudeDesktop: Reopen Claude.app, start a new Code session and verify the model and connection settings. Restart terminal CLI sessions separately.
restartExit_gemini: Exit the Gemini CLI session normally in its terminal.
restartReopen_gemini: Run gemini in your working directory, start a new session and verify the configuration.
restartClaudeDistinction: Claude Code CLI and the Claude desktop app are separate entry points; automatic restart only affects Claude.app — CLI sessions in your terminal still need a manual restart.
restartScope: If quitting is refused or times out, save your work and quit manually. If starting fails, open the app manually. Restart failure does not undo applied configuration.
restartReason_cli_session_unsafe: A CLI session may be running work that cannot be closed safely. Restart it manually with the steps below.
restartReason_platform_unsupported: Automatic restart is not supported for this target on this platform.
restartReason_not_installed: No installation of this target was detected.
restartReason_config_not_shared: This desktop app does not read the CLI configuration just written, so restarting it would not apply the change.
restartReason_identity_unverified: The app identity could not be verified, so automatic restart was skipped.
restartReason_unsupported: This target does not support automatic restart.
restartConfirmRunning: {{target}} is currently running. It will be asked to quit normally, then the same app will be started again once it exits.
restartConfirmStopped: {{target}} is not running right now; it will simply be started.
restartConfirmRisk: In-progress tasks or unsaved work may be interrupted.
restartStage_waiting_for_exit: Waiting for the old process to exit
restartResult_not_running_started: {{target}} was not running; it has been started.
restartResult_unsupported: Automatic restart of {{target}} is not supported in this environment.
restartResult_exit_refused: {{target}} refused the normal quit request. Quit it manually, then try again.
restartResult_exit_timeout: Timed out waiting for {{target}} to exit. The process was not force-killed and no second instance was started.
restartResult_launch_failed: Failed to start {{target}}. Reopen it manually.
restartErrExpired: This restart authorization has expired. Apply the model again before retrying.
restartErrBusy: Another target is being restarted. Please wait.
restartErrGeneric: The restart could not be completed. Use the manual steps.
restartFailedKeepsApply: The failed restart does not change the configuration applied in this operation.
envCheck_git_missing: Git not detected; some features may be unavailable
envCheck_python_missing: Python not detected (optional for some workflows)
envCheck_node_missing: Node.js/npm not detected; one-click tool installs need npm
envCheck_node_npm_missing: Node.js found but npm is missing; installs need npm
envCheck_writable_not_writable: Config directory is not writable; check permissions
envCheck_relay_unreachable: Cannot reach the relay station; check network or proxy
envCheck_relay_not_logged_in: Not logged in; relay check skipped
appUpdateHint: Updates download and install only after your confirmation; the app restarts during the process.
update_not_configured: Update service is not configured; get new versions from the release channel
update_latest: You are on the latest version
update_check_failed: Update check failed; try again later
update_install_failed: Update failed; the app was not changed. Retry later or install manually
envDesktopInstalledSeparate: Installed; separate from CLI config and unaffected by model apply
envDesktopMissingOptional: Not installed (optional; the CLI works without it)
envDesktopUnsupported: Automatic detection isn't available on this platform; download the desktop app to install it manually
restartNeedApply: Apply a model or API config first
restartManualOnly: Manual restart only — open the guide for steps
restartHelpScope: RelayDesk only restarts a verified desktop app after your confirmation, for targets applied successfully this time. It never restarts automatically, never force-kills by default, and never starts a second instance while the old process is alive.
restartHelpSupported: macOS auto-restart: ChatGPT (Codex), legacy Codex.app, Claude.app. Manual only: Claude Code CLI, Gemini CLI. Not supported: Gemini.app, Windows/Linux desktop restart.
restartHelpEntry: To select an app and restart it, close this guide and use “Restart tools” in the Model center toolbar.
walletSubtitle: Review your balance, choose a top-up method and track crediting.
topupNotReadyHint: Could not read the relay configuration. Retry or open the official wallet.
topupUnavailableHint: Ask the relay maintainer to confirm online top-up and payment channels.
topupQuotePending: The relay calculates the payable amount. Verify it again at the official checkout.
topupQuoteUnavailable: Could not retrieve the relay quote. Please retry.
topupPaymentNotReady: Complete payment in the official wallet
topupPaymentNotReadyHint: Review amounts, methods and live quotes here. Checkout integration is pending; select your amount and method again in the official wallet.
topupOpenOfficial: Open the official site to choose an amount
topupOpenOfficialFailed: The official site could not be opened. Visit the relay address manually.
topupOrderQueryMissingHint: The relay history request failed. Refresh to retry.
usageSubtitle: Review requests, token consumption and charges by model.
usageIncompleteHint: Totals come from relay model analytics. Token breakdowns come from usage logs for the same interval and appear only when request counts and charges match. Unavailable or unreconciled fields are —.
usageModelsUnavailableHint: Could not read relay statistics. Retry; local proxy statistics will not replace relay billing.
usageNoData: No model usage in this range
rememberLoginUnavailable: Only an encrypted session token is stored; Keychain is not accessed
savedLoginHint: Restore an encrypted session without entering the password again
savedLoginExpired: This sign-in has expired. Enter the password again.
savedLoginMissing: That saved account is no longer available. Choose another account.
savedLoginStorageFailed: Saved sign-in details could not be read or updated. Sign in with your username and password.
topupCheckoutHint: Keep this amount and payment method; confirmation opens this order’s checkout in your browser.
topupConfirmHint: Create a pending order and open the official payment service. Verify the final amount at checkout. Credit is added only after payment.
topupCheckoutOpened: Order created; checkout opened. Awaiting payment
topupCheckoutFailed: Could not create the order or open checkout. Close this dialog and refresh order history before retrying to check for an existing pending order.
usageDetails_matched: Usage logs reconcile with totals. Cache fields not returned by the relay remain —.
usageDetails_unreconciled: Some logs differ from totals in requests, tokens or charges. Their breakdowns are withheld; refresh later.
usageDetails_incomplete: Usage logs could not be fully loaded (up to 5,000 per query). Try a shorter interval. Totals still come from the relay.
usageDetails_failed: Usage logs failed to load or timed out. Totals remain available; refresh to retry token breakdowns.
rememberNotSaved: Signed in, but sign-in details could not be saved. This session is available; enter your credentials again next time.
usageChartCoverage: Data from relay model analytics. Hover to inspect each model.
forgetSavedLoginFailed: Could not remove the saved account. Try again.
loginCooldown: Login requests must be at least 30 seconds apart. Wait before trying again; no automatic retry will occur.
sessionOnlyLogin: Session-only sign-in. No password storage or Keychain access.
usageLogsUnavailable: Usage logs could not be fully loaded; token breakdowns are unavailable. Charts, requests, total tokens and charges come from relay analytics.
usageLogCoverage: Breakdown from {{count}} usage logs; not yet reconciled with relay totals
usageDetailSource: Requests, total tokens and charges come from model analytics; input, output and cache counts come from usage logs.
walletBalanceRefreshFailed: Balance could not be updated. The last retrieved balance is still shown; please retry.
topupCreditedBalanceUpdated: This order has been credited and your balance is updated.
topupOrderRefreshFailed: Could not confirm the latest status of this order. Please check again later.
topupIntro: Choose an amount and payment method, then continue to checkout.
envCheck_webview2_missing: WebView2 Runtime is missing; install the Evergreen Bootstrapper
envCheck_webview2_not_required: WebView2 is not required on this platform
envCheck_claude_missing: Claude Code CLI is not installed
